turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Let us talk about reading in groups led by the teacher.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukufundisa abafundi ngokwamazinga abo okufunda kuyindlela ebalulekile eyenza ukwazi ukubona ukuthi abafundi bayathuthuka yini ekufundeni.
turns.en: Teaching learners according to their reading levels is an important way that makes you able to see if the learners are progressing in reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kubalulekile ukuthi ukwazi ukukhetha izincwadi ezisesezingeni labo ukuze bangazitholi sebebhekene nenkinga yokufunda izincwadi ezilukhuni kakhulu.
turns.en: It is important that you are able to choose books that are at their level so that they do not find themselves facing the problem of reading books that are too difficult.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: bebhekene nenkinga yokufunda izincwadi ezilula kakhulu.
turns.en: facing the problem of reading books that are too easy.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda umsebenzi wale-module, uzokwazi ukuqonda ukufunda ngamaqembu aholwa nguthisha,
turns.en: After finishing the work of this module, you will be able to understand reading in groups led by the teacher,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukubalula izindlela zokwakha amaqembu ngokwamazinga okufunda kwabafundi,
turns.en: to list the ways of forming groups according to the reading levels of the learners,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukuqonda izigaba ezisetshenziswayo ukwenza isifundo sokufunda ngamaqembu,
turns.en: to understand the stages used to do a lesson of reading in groups,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: ukwakha imisebenzi efanelekile yesifundo sokufunda ngamaqembu,
turns.en: to create appropriate activities for a lesson of reading in groups,

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: nokubalula izindlela ezingasetshenziswa ukuhlola isifundo sokufunda ngamaqembu.
turns.en: and to list the ways that can be used to assess a lesson of reading in groups.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: to assess a lesson of reading in groups.
